component.name: Sahne
component.summary: Synchronized, animated lyrics for your music player

description.p: Sahne shows synchronized, word-by-word animated lyrics for the song playing in Spotify or any other player that reports to the system's media controls, over a backdrop made from the album artwork's colors.

ul.li: Six lyrics styles, from a calm classic view to kinetic type and a 3D wall of lines
Backdrops and cover effects generated from the artwork
Mini player, screensaver mode and per-track timing correction
No account or API key needed; lyrics come from LRCLIB

screenshot.caption: Lyrics next to the album cover
